card.name: Open parenthesis after HIV drug names
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis (or a plus sign) right after an antiretroviral drug name such as efavirenz, abacavir, atazanavir, ritonavir or emtricitabine. It is followed by a dose, an abbreviation or a table reference.

modes.label: Parenthesis with dose
modes.description: An opening bracket after an HIV drug name introduces a dose in mg.

modes.description: A plus sign after a drug name in a list of combined regimens.
